# Intent: TODO

The owner's own statement of what is wanted and why. Write it in your words;
an agent proposes edits rather than making them. Set `status: accepted` when
it is ready for the spec.

## Problem

What is wrong or missing, and for whom.

## Proposed outcome

What exists when this is done, described from the outside.

## Priorities

What matters most, in order, so tradeoffs have a tiebreaker.

## Scope

What is in, and what is explicitly out. A full wish list can go here too, with
the first version marked.

## Affected users and systems

Who or what uses the result, and anything it must stay compatible with.

## Constraints

Language, budget, licenses, deadlines, or anything else that limits the design.

## Success criteria

Observable results that show the outcome was reached.

## Open questions

Questions the spec must answer or carry forward.
